notes: The Dartboard is a puzzle object inside the Billiard Room, not a room in its own right -- it has no rooms.json record. Solving it is a player-skill act; this sim assumes puzzles are solved (docs/doctrine.md), so there is no action id for it -- engine/effects/rooms/billiard_room.py auto-resolves it on entry to a freshly-drafted Billiard Room, once per day (owner ruling).

The wiki's own DataMinedBox: 'The odds of receiving each item are given according to the following table (first row's condition applies).' Rows are checked top-to-bottom: Veteran Mode / Room 46 reached before / Day 22+ first, then Day 13-21, Day 8-12, Day 1-7. The bands array below preserves that order; billiard_room.py checks the open-ended (max_day null) band's own trigger before falling through to the finite day ranges, so the day cutoff for that band lives here in data, not as a Python constant.

Day 13-21's weights are published in nineteenths (2/19, 6/19, 4/19, 7/19), not percent -- verified against the live wiki page, not a transcription artefact. Stored here as the raw integer numerators; Rng.roll_weighted divides by the weights' own sum, so they need no rescaling to 100.

Also published: 'If an item is not in the item pool when the items spawn (when the dartboard puzzle is solved), the fallback priority is Keycard -> 2 keys.' billiard_room.py generalises this to every rolled outcome (not just Secret Garden Key/Silver Key): a rolled Keycard that is already held falls back to 2 keys the same way.

The wiki's 2-key reward is a plain 'basic keys' pair, i.e. state.keys += 2, not a special/door-specific key -- see the possible-items line 'A pile of 2 keys - most commonly' is the modal outcome in the two earliest bands.
Not modelled here: the Bullseye Trophy (the 40th lifetime dartboard solve) -- a save-scoped counter, unruled; see docs/open_tasks.md's scoping pass.
